title: 第一卷 第13章 有自己的家了
slug: 一路逃荒一路富手握空间带飞全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

周员外走了，王桂花的脸比锅底还黑。

她杵在堂屋门口，拐棍戳得地面咚咚响，浑身的气没处撒，一双三角眼在屋里扫了一圈，最后死死盯住了沈鹿溪。

“好啊，好啊！你个丧良心的东西！把周老爷气走了，你满意了？二十两银子，二十两银子啊！让你这么一搅和，全没了！”

沈鹿溪站在堂屋中间，一动没动。

院门外的村民越围越多，有人踮着脚往里看，有人拉着旁边的人小声嘀咕。

沈家闹出这么大动静，整个村子都惊动了。

沈鹿溪等王桂花骂完了那口气，才开口。

“奶奶，周员外的事过了就过了，咱们说正事。”

“什么正事？！”

“分家。”

王桂花的拐棍又往地上戳了一下：“分什么家！我说了不分就不分！”

沈鹿溪没跟她争，转头看向方秉文。

方秉文从袖子里取出分家文书，走到堂屋桌前，将文书展开铺好。

“王老太太，在下方秉文，青川镇讼师。这份分家文书是按照大衍律拟的，条目清楚，合情合法。您要是同意，咱们今天就把事情办了，大家好聚好散。您要是不同意……”

他顿了一下，目光平静地看着王桂花。

“那就只能走衙门了。私卖良家子为妾这件事，今天在场这么多人都看见了，周员外也跑不掉。到了衙门，可就不是分家这么简单了。”

王桂花的脸抽了一下。

赵翠屏在旁边急了：“什么衙门不衙门的，吓唬谁呢！”

方秉文看都没看她，继续对王桂花说：“方才的律法您也听到了。王老太太，您今年多大岁数了？挨得起八十杖吗？”

王桂花的嘴唇哆嗦了两下，拐棍攥得咯吱响。

沈德厚在角落里咳了一声，慢悠悠地开口：“桂花婶子，既然孩子们提出来了，讼师也在，不如坐下来好好谈谈。分家是正经事，又不是什么丢人的事，村里哪家没分过家？”

里正发话了，分量不一样。

王桂花再横，也不敢当着里正和讼师的面撒泼。

她咬着牙，一屁股坐回太师椅上，拐棍横在膝盖上，脸上的表情能拧出水来。

“行，你们说。”

沈鹿溪上前一步。

“奶，分家的事很简单，就几条。”

她伸出手，一条一条地数。

“头一条，田产。当年分家时的文书上写得清楚，二房应得五亩水田三亩旱地，这些年全在大房名下，一亩都没给我们。我们不追究以前的，只要求按文书把该给二房的田产还回来。”

沈大牛在角落里坐不住了：“什么文书！哪有什么文书！”

沈鹿溪把田产文书的抄件递给方秉文，方秉文接过来，念了一遍。

白纸黑字，年月日期，分家时在场人的签名画押，清清楚楚。

沈大牛的脸一阵红一阵白，张了张嘴，没敢再吭声。

赵翠屏急得直扯沈大牛的袖子，沈大牛甩开她的手，低下了头。

Page (1/3)

When Zhou Yuanwai left, Wang Guihua's face was darker than the bottom of the pot.

She stood at the door of the main room, her cane making a thumping sound on the ground, and her whole body was full of anger. She swept around the room with her triangular eyes, and finally fixed her eyes on Shen Luxi.

"Okay, okay! You unconscionable thing! Are you satisfied that you made Mr. Zhou angry? Twenty taels of silver, twenty taels of silver! It's all gone if you mess with it like this!"

Shen Luxi stood in the middle of the main room, motionless.

More and more villagers gathered outside the courtyard gate. Some stood on tiptoe to look in, while others pulled the people next to them and whispered.

The Shen family made such a big noise, and the whole village was alarmed.

Shen Luxi waited for Wang Guihua to finish cursing before speaking.

"Grandma, let's get over what happened with Yuan Zhou. Let's get down to business."

"What's the matter?!"

"Split the family."

Wang Guihua poked the ground with her cane again: "What kind of family separation! I said we won't separate them!"

Shen Luxi did not argue with her, but turned to look at Fang Bingwen.

Fang Bingwen took out the family separation documents from his sleeve, walked to the table in the main room, unfolded the documents and laid them out.

"Old Mrs. Wang, I am writing below, the lawyer of Qingchuan Town. This family separation document is drafted in accordance with the Dayan Law. The terms are clear and legal. If you agree, we will settle the matter today so that everyone can get together and go. If you don't agree..."

He paused and looked at Wang Guihua calmly.

"Then we can only go through the Yamen. So many people here today have seen the private sale of a good wife as a concubine, and Zhou Yuanwai can't escape. When we get to the Yamen, it's not as simple as dividing the family."

Wang Guihua's face twitched.

Zhao Cuiping was anxious beside him: "Why is there no government office? Who are you trying to scare!"

Fang Bingwen didn't even look at her, and continued to say to Wang Guihua: "You also heard the law just now. Mrs. Wang, how old are you this year? Can you afford eighty canes?"

Wang Guihua's lips trembled twice, and her cane clenched loudly.

Shen Dehou coughed in the corner and spoke slowly: "Aunt Osmanthus, since the children have brought it up and the lawyer is here, why not sit down and have a good talk. Separating a family is a serious matter and it is not a shameful thing. Which family in the village has not done so?"

Li Zheng spoke, but the weight was different.

No matter how arrogant Wang Guihua was, she would not dare to behave in front of Li Zheng and Litigation Master.

She gritted her teeth and sat back on the Taishi chair, with the crutch across her knees and an expression on her face that could make her cry.

"Okay, you say it."

Shen Luxi took a step forward.

"Nai, the matter of dividing the family is very simple, just a few things."

She stretched out her hand and counted them one by one.

"The first item is the land. It was clearly written in the documents when the family was divided that the second house should get five acres of paddy fields and three acres of dry land. All these years have been in the name of the first house, and not one acre has been given to us. We do not pursue the past. We only ask that the land that should be given to the second house be returned to the second house according to the document."

Shen Daniu couldn't sit still in the corner: "What kind of documents! There are no documents!"

Shen Luxi handed the copy of the land property document to Fang Bingwen, and Fang Bingwen took it and read it over.

There are black and white words on the paper, the year, month and date, and the signatures of the people present when the family was separated. They are all clear.

Shen Daniu's face turned red and white, and he opened his mouth, but did not dare to say anything again.

Zhao Cuiping was so anxious that she pulled Shen Daniu's sleeves. Shen Daniu threw her hand away and lowered his head.
